mapper.sql: select p.profile_id, p.customer_id, p.dealer_level, p.auth_regions, p.auth_categories, p.deposit_amount, p.coop_start_date, p.coop_end_date, p.status, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, c.customer_no, c.customer_name, c.parent_customer_id, u.nick_name as user_name, d.dept_name, pc.customer_name as parent_customer_name, c.credit_status, (select ifnull(sum(o.order_amount), 0) from mk_order o where o.customer_id = c.customer_id and o.del_flag = '0' and o.order_status in ('2', '3', '4') and o.create_time >= date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-01')) as period_purchase_amount, (select ifnull(sum(s.rebate_amount - s.offset_amount), 0) from mk_rebate_settle s where s.customer_id = c.customer_id and s.del_flag = '0' and s.offset_status in ('0', '1')) as unsettled_rebate from mk_dealer_profile p inner join mk_customer c on p.customer_id = c.customer_id left join mk_customer pc on c.parent_customer_id = pc.customer_id left join sys_user u on c.user_id = u.user_id left join sys_dept d on c.dept_id = d.dept_id
mapper.insert: insert into mk_dealer_profile (customer_id, dealer_level, auth_regions, auth_categories, deposit_amount, coop_start_date, coop_end_date, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{customerId}, #{dealerLevel}, #{authRegions}, #{authCategories}, #{depositAmount}, #{coopStartDate}, #{coopEndDate}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete:
delete from mk_dealer_profile where profile_id in
#{profileId}
